G1_unambiguity.justification: The definition of a deadlocked trio and the lexicographic tie-break rule are precise and admit only one reasonable interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement provides the input bounds and format, validity guarantee, output format, ordering requirement, tie-break rule, and examples.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For a trio of three vertices, every member having a nonempty and distinct internal conflict set holds exactly when all three pairs conflict, so the rewrite selects precisely the same lexicographically smallest triple.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is clear and readable, though its elaborate internal-conflict-set definition is unnecessarily contrived compared with directly asking for a conflicting triangle.
